title: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd - 539871 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Thyrocare FY26 consolidated revenue rose 21% to INR829 crore and Q4 PAT rose 128% to INR48.7 crore; management guides mid-to-high teens growth in FY27.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue grew 20% YoY to INR224 crore, with standalone at INR210 crore (+21%), and EBITDA margin was 34%. Gross margin rose about 113 bps YoY to 74.7%, which management said is the steady-state range going forward (73-74%). Partnership growth slowed to 23% in Q4 from 32% for the year, which management attributed to a one-off INR4 crore Kumbh-camp base effect and insurance pricing normalisation. Management said test volumes were boosted by biochemistry price cuts in the quarter, and it is launching specialty (allergy, genomics) and an allied consumables brand.

financial_highlights.metric: Operating cash flow after tax, FY26

segments.name: Pathology
segments.commentary: FY26 pathology revenue grew 22%. Aarogyam (preventive, about 33% of mix) grew about 20% in Q4; Jaanch (curative, about 2% of pathology revenue) grew 66% YoY.

segments.name: Franchisee business
segments.commentary: Grew 18% in FY26 and 21% in Q4 FY26; active franchisees reached about 10,800, with management targeting about 500 additions per quarter.

segments.name: Partnership business
segments.commentary: Grew 32% in FY26 and 23% in Q4 FY26; insurance and healthtech drove growth, and the Q4 slowdown reflects a roughly INR4 crore one-off base effect from FY25 camps.

segments.name: Radiology
segments.commentary: Revenue declined 6% in FY26 after centre consolidation; management said bottom line improved.

segments.name: Tanzania
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 75% YoY; quarterly losses are under INR1 crore and the unit has not yet broken even.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at mid-to-high teens, about 75% from volume and 25% from mix; no plan to raise prices.
Steady-state gross margin guided at 73-74%, barring reagent price increases linked to the Middle East conflict or supply chain.
EBITDA margin expected to hold near FY26 base (about 34% normalised) in FY27; specialty not expected to add margin upside in FY27.
Effective tax rate expected at 28-29% going forward, versus about 23-24% in FY26 due to deferred tax timing differences.
Capex guided at about INR40 crore a year, covering maintenance and expansion; FY26 capitalisation was about INR35 crore.
Specialty test mix targeted at 15-20% of volume within 3 years, in line with competitors.
capex_capacity: Lab network at 40 labs in India plus 1 in Tanzania (management also cited 39 labs plus 1 in Tanzania); seven new labs opened in FY26 at Bhagalpur, Mandi, Roorkee, Kashmir, Davanagere, Vijayawada and Gwalior.
Average lab utilisation about 65%; a Thyrocare lab is reachable within 150 km anywhere in India.
FY26 capex capitalisation about INR35 crore plus machines taken on lease; cash-flow capex payout about INR20 crore.
Specialty launch capex only INR5-8 crore; specialty team of about 40 people is mostly opex.
Genomics launched May 1, 2026, starting with NIPT panels in top 10 northern cities.
demand_pricing: Tests processed 210 million in FY26 (+23%); patients served 19.2 million (+15%); Q4 test volume growth about 29%, helped by biochemistry price cuts.
Q4 processed 80.3 lakh samples; franchisee additions expected at about 500 per quarter, with Q3 seasonally weak.
Management said realisation per test is INR30-40 and specialty tests can be around INR1,000.
Reagent costs: vendors seeking price increases on the stronger dollar; 2-3 months of inventory held and no availability disruption yet.
Franchisee mix about 20% urban/metro Tier 1 and 80% Tier 2 and beyond.

qa_highlights.question: How will test volume growth and margins hold in FY27, and is GLP-1 a driver?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q4 test volume growth (about 29%) reflected biochemistry price cuts rather than GLP-1, and guided to mid-to-high teens revenue growth in FY27, mostly from volume.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capex outlook for FY27 given low FY26 spend?
qa_highlights.answer: Vikram Gupta said about INR35 crore was capitalised in FY26; management said maintenance and expansion capex would be about INR40 crore, with growth driven by franchise addition rather than capex.

qa_highlights.question: What is the revenue per test and specialty mix outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said specialty could reach 15-20% of mix in 3 years and expects a material rise in revenue per test over the next couple of years, but gave no number yet.

qa_highlights.question: What is the allied consumables launch?
qa_highlights.answer: Management withheld details until June or July, describing it as an allied services brand that leverages Thyrocare's own high consumption of allied diagnostic consumables.

qa_highlights.question: What is the insurance business growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said insurance grew about 45% YoY in FY26 off a small base, and declined to give segment-level guidance for FY27.

risks_watch: Partnership growth slowed to 23% in Q4 from 32% for the year; management says the dip is one-off, so track Q1 FY27 partnership growth.
Reagent and raw material costs may rise on the dollar and the Middle East conflict, which would pressure the 73-74% gross margin range.
Specialty and genomics are early-stage with lower gross margin percentages; the pricing approach could dilute margins before scale.
Tax rate stepping up to 28-29% from about 23-24% will weigh on PAT growth.
Radiology declined 6% in FY26 after centre consolidation; watch for stabilisation.
Franchisee addition pace (about 500 per quarter) and onboarding quality are a key volume lever.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, volumes and cash generation, but cautious on FY27 specifics: management was non-committal on specialty and allied launch details and declined segment guidance. The call was disrupted by a Rajdeep Panwar takeover and a moderator-managed queue.
key_quotes: Our strategy remains more or less the same. So, the key drivers of growth for us are franchise expansion.
I would say almost 75% of the revenue will come from volume and maybe about 25% from mix. We have no intention at this point in time to increase prices.
So, I think margins will be in that 73% to 74% range.
So, we are calibrated in the investments, which we are doing.

adds.what: Seven new labs opened in FY26 (Bhagalpur, Mandi, Roorkee, Kashmir, Davanagere, Vijayawada, Gwalior) - already live, no further lab additions quantified

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guided at mid-to-high teens (midpoint ~15-17%), about 75% from volume and 25% from mix with no price increases; backed by franchisee additions (~500/quarter), partnership growth and new specialty/genomics launches, but no specific new capacity or order book quantified, and utilisation is ~65%.
